parsed.notes:
Requirements items are required; Nice To Have items are optional. Technologies appearing only in the introduction or Responsibilities are excluded.
Alternative technologies and example tasks are each retained under the guide's examples rule.
Edge-model optimization is provisionally mapped to inference-optimization; the posting does not explicitly specify inference optimization.
Experiment tools is provisionally mapped to experiment-tracking, although tracking is not explicitly named.
Inference systems is left unmapped rather than equated with model serving. Multimodal techniques are not treated as synonymous with LLMs.
The phrase beyond model training is read literally as introducing the explicitly requested additional experience, not as a separate model-development requirement.
English fluency and the Berlin office location do not establish a German requirement.
